name: MRC Manual Muscle Testing Scale
description: 6-level ordinal scale (0–5) for clinician-graded muscle strength testing. Applied per individual muscle group.
shirleySays: ICC 0.80–0.95 (inter-rater varies by joint and examiner experience). No established MCID; clinical convention treats 1-grade change as meaningful. Normed across ICU/critical illness, GBS, NMD, SCI, and post-surgical populations. Ordinal scale limits parametric stats — use sum scores cautiously.

scoring.mcidNote: 1-grade change accepted as clinically meaningful by convention
